lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 山上下雪了，可是風不大。

choices.alt: Snow: snowflakes fall straight down on the mountain path; snow covers the trees and the bench, and the trees stand still
Rain: heavy rain falls on the mountain path; puddles on the ground, no snow, the trees stand still
Wind: a strong wind bends the trees and blows leaves across the dry mountain path; no rain, no snow

versions.alt: A small mountain inn lobby on a snowy evening. Left: behind a wooden front desk the inn owner, a middle-aged man, holds an open paper map in his hand and talks with a young woman traveler; she stands at the desk with a backpack on, laughing with a big happy smile, and a few banknotes lie on the desk in front of her. Right: a young man traveler stands by a big window looking out; outside, heavy snow is falling and the mountains are all white

prompt.traditional: 旅館老闆手裡拿＿＿一張地圖，在跟一個女生說話。
prompt.simplified: 旅馆老板手里拿＿＿一张地图，在跟一个女生说话。

answer.traditional: 旅館老闆手裡拿著一張地圖，在跟一個女生說話。
answer.simplified: 旅馆老板手里拿着一张地图，在跟一个女生说话。
answer.pinyin: Lǚguǎn lǎobǎn shǒu lǐ názhe yì zhāng dìtú, zài gēn yí ge nǚshēng shuōhuà.
answer.english: The inn owner is holding a map in his hand and talking with a girl.

questions.why: 拿著 shows he is holding the map right now while he talks (在說話). 得 needs a description after it, and 拿過 (has held before) does not fit something happening now.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生下了公車，＿＿到旅館來了。
prompt.simplified: 那个女生下了公车，＿＿到旅馆来了。

answer.traditional: 那個女生下了公車，就到旅館來了。
answer.simplified: 那个女生下了公车，就到旅馆来了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng xià le gōngchē, jiù dào lǚguǎn lái le.
answer.english: The girl got off the bus and came straight to the inn.

questions.why: 下了公車 is a finished action with 了, and 就 brings the next one right after it. 再 is for a next step that hasn't happened yet, so it can't go with the 了 at the end; 在 (in the middle of) can't come before 到…來了 like this.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生跟老闆聊天，笑得很＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那个女生跟老板聊天，笑得很＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那個女生跟老闆聊天，笑得很開心。
answer.simplified: 那个女生跟老板聊天，笑得很开心。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng gēn lǎobǎn liáotiān, xiào de hěn kāixīn.
answer.english: The girl is chatting with the owner, laughing happily.

questions.why: She is laughing with a big happy smile in the picture: 笑得很開心. She does not look nervous (緊張) or strange (奇怪).

versions.alt: A small mountain inn lobby on a snowy evening. Left: behind a wooden front desk the inn owner, a middle-aged man, holds an open paper map in his hand and talks with a young woman traveler; she stands at the desk with a backpack on, laughing with a big happy smile, and a few banknotes lie on the desk in front of her. Right: a young man traveler stands by a big window looking out; outside, heavy snow is falling and the mountains are all white

prompt.traditional: 那個男生＿＿窗戶外面看，外面的山都白了。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生＿＿窗户外面看，外面的山都白了。

answer.traditional: 那個男生往窗戶外面看，外面的山都白了。
answer.simplified: 那个男生往窗户外面看，外面的山都白了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng wǎng chuānghù wàimiàn kàn, wàimiàn de shān dōu bái le.
answer.english: The boy looks out of the window; the mountains outside have all turned white.

questions.why: 往 + place + 看 means looking toward it: he looks out of the window. 跟 and 給 need a person after them.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生付＿＿錢，就開始跟老闆聊天。
prompt.simplified: 那个女生付＿＿钱，就开始跟老板聊天。

answer.traditional: 那個女生付了錢，就開始跟老闆聊天。
answer.simplified: 那个女生付了钱，就开始跟老板聊天。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng fù le qián, jiù kāishǐ gēn lǎobǎn liáotiān.
answer.english: After the girl paid, she started chatting with the owner.

questions.why: V了O，就…: 了 after 付 makes paying a finished first step, and 就 brings the next one. 付著 (still paying) can't lead to a next step with 就, and 付的錢 is only a noun with no action.

prompt.traditional: 外面的雪下＿＿很大，他們都不想出去了。
prompt.simplified: 外面的雪下＿＿很大，他们都不想出去了。

answer.traditional: 外面的雪下得很大，他們都不想出去了。
answer.simplified: 外面的雪下得很大，他们都不想出去了。
answer.pinyin: Wàimiàn de xuě xià de hěn dà, tāmen dōu bù xiǎng chūqù le.
answer.english: It is snowing hard outside, so they don't want to go out anymore.

questions.why: 得 comes after the verb and before how it is going: 雪下得很大, the snow is falling hard. 了 and 著 cannot come before 很大 like this.

passage.traditional: 上個週末，我跟家人去花蓮玩。花蓮在台灣的{1}部，我們是坐火車去的。到了花蓮，我們先去旅館，再{2}公車去海邊。那裡的風很大，可是我們玩得很{3}。晚上，我們在旅館附近吃了很多花蓮有名的{4}。
passage.simplified: 上个周末，我跟家人去花莲玩。花莲在台湾的{1}部，我们是坐火车去的。到了花莲，我们先去旅馆，再{2}公车去海边。那里的风很大，可是我们玩得很{3}。晚上，我们在旅馆附近吃了很多花莲有名的{4}。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ gēn jiārén qù Huālián wán. Huālián zài Táiwān de dōngbù, wǒmen shì zuò huǒchē qù de. Dào le Huālián, wǒmen xiān qù lǚguǎn, zài dā gōngchē qù hǎibiān. Nàlǐ de fēng hěn dà, kěshì wǒmen wán de hěn gāoxìng. Wǎnshàng, wǒmen zài lǚguǎn fùjìn chī le hěn duō Huālián yǒumíng de shíwù.
passage.english: Last weekend I went to Hualien with my family. Hualien is in eastern Taiwan, and we went there by train. In Hualien we went to our hotel first, and then we took a bus to the beach. It was very windy there, but we had a great time. In the evening we ate lots of Hualien's famous food near our hotel.

questions.why: 東部 is the eastern part: Hualien is in eastern Taiwan.
搭公車 means to take a bus. 騎 is for a bike (騎腳踏車); you never 騎 a bus.
After 得 comes how it went: 玩得很高興, they had a great time.
有名的 describes the noun after it: 花蓮有名的食物 is Hualien's famous food.

passage.traditional: 上個月我去高雄旅行。我{1}想住一家小旅館，可是那裡沒有房間了，後來住在一家大飯店。房間很漂亮，浴室也很{2}，洗澡很舒服。飯店離海邊很{3}，走路兩分鐘就到了。晚上我在海邊看風景，{4}了很多相片。
passage.simplified: 上个月我去高雄旅行。我{1}想住一家小旅馆，可是那里没有房间了，后来住在一家大饭店。房间很漂亮，浴室也很{2}，洗澡很舒服。饭店离海边很{3}，走路两分钟就到了。晚上我在海边看风景，{4}了很多相片。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Gāoxióng lǚxíng. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng zhù yì jiā xiǎo lǚguǎn, kěshì nàlǐ méiyǒu fángjiān le, hòulái zhù zài yì jiā dà fàndiàn. Fángjiān hěn piàoliàng, yùshì yě hěn gānjìng, xǐzǎo hěn shūfu. Fàndiàn lí hǎibiān hěn jìn, zǒulù liǎng fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Wǎnshàng wǒ zài hǎibiān kàn fēngjǐng, zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
passage.english: Last month I took a trip to Kaohsiung. At first I wanted to stay at a small inn, but it had no rooms left, so in the end I stayed at a big hotel. The room was beautiful, and the bathroom was clean too, so showering was nice. The hotel was very close to the beach: it was a two-minute walk. In the evening I looked at the view by the sea and took lots of photos.

questions.why: 本來 gives the first plan; 後來 later in the sentence tells what changed.
浴室也很乾淨: the bathroom was clean too, so showering was nice.
離 + place + 很近: a two-minute walk means the hotel is close to the beach, not far (遠).
照相片 means to take photos: 照了很多相片, took lots of photos.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
今天老闆請我們吃晚飯，所以我下班以後不回家吃飯了。我十點以前一定回家，妳不要等我。
妹妹
text.simplified:
姐姐：
今天老板请我们吃晚饭，所以我下班以后不回家吃饭了。我十点以前一定回家，你不要等我。
妹妹
text.pinyin: Jiějie: Jīntiān lǎobǎn qǐng wǒmen chī wǎnfàn, suǒyǐ wǒ xiàbān yǐhòu bù huí jiā chī fàn le. Wǒ shí diǎn yǐqián yídìng huí jiā, nǐ búyào děng wǒ. Mèimei
text.english: Big sister, Today my boss is treating us to dinner, so I won't come home to eat after work. I'll definitely be home before ten, so don't wait for me. Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 妹妹今天晚上要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹今天晚上要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei jīntiān wǎnshàng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the younger sister doing this evening?

choices.english: wait at home for her sister

questions.why: 老闆請我們吃晚飯 and 不回家吃飯: her boss is taking them to dinner, so she won't eat at home. She asks her sister not to wait for her.

text.traditional:
宜文：
這個星期六晚上，我們一起去看燈會吧！中明週末要上班，他說下班以後也會來。聽說今年的燈籠跟去年的一樣，有很多動物，大人小孩都喜歡。
友美
text.simplified:
宜文：
这个星期六晚上，我们一起去看灯会吧！中明周末要上班，他说下班以后也会来。听说今年的灯笼跟去年的一样，有很多动物，大人小孩都喜欢。
友美
text.pinyin: Yíwén: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn dēnghuì ba! Zhōngmíng zhōumò yào shàngbān, tā shuō xiàbān yǐhòu yě huì lái. Tīngshuō jīnnián de dēnglóng gēn qùnián de yíyàng, yǒu hěn duō dòngwù, dàrén xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān. Yǒuměi
text.english: Yiwen, let's go to the lantern show together this Saturday evening! Zhongming has to work this weekend, but he says he'll come too after work. I hear this year's lanterns are the same as last year's: there are lots of animals, and adults and children all like them. Youmei

prompt.pinyin: Jīnnián de dēnglóng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What are this year's lanterns like?

questions.why: 今年的燈籠跟去年的一樣，有很多動物: this year's lanterns are like last year's, with lots of animals. The note says 一樣 (the same), not 不一樣, and 大人小孩都喜歡 means adults like them too, not only children.

focus.zh: 跟去年的一樣，有很多動物
focus.en: like last year's, with many animals
